{"consolidated_memory":"## NaN Feature Encoder Issues in ml/features/encoder.py

A recurring series of NaN (not-a-number) value problems in the feature encoder, all stemming from different root causes but sharing the same symptom and repro method. File consistently affected: ml/features/encoder.py. Common repro: encode the batch holding the sparse column. Common signal: NaN value in one output column. All work on the ml pipeline side.

### Occasion 1: [2026-01-17] Five Percent Rollout Bucket
- **Trigger:** Only for accounts in the five percent rollout bucket
- **Root cause:** Two writes never wrapped in a transaction
- **Fix:** Wrapped both writes in one transaction
- **PR:** #1894, branch: fix/nan-feature-1
- **Result:** Job finished in 3 minutes instead of 4 hours

### Occasion 2: [2026-01-28] Large Payloads
- **Trigger:** Only for payloads above roughly two megabytes
- **Root cause:** Missing Unicode normalisation before hashing
- **Fix:** Normalised to NFC ahead of the digest
- **PR:** #2941, branch: fix/nan-feature-2
- **Result:** p99 latency fell from 7.7 s to 537 ms

### Occasion 3: [2026-04-08] Non-ASCII Names
- **Trigger:** Only for records carrying non-ASCII names
- **Root cause:** Config loader reading the wrong environment file
- **Fix:** Made environment selection explicit and failed closed on ambiguity
- **PR:** #6529, branch: fix/nan-feature-4
- **Result:** Throughput rose 36 percent, to 147 requests per second

### Occasion 4: [2026-04-25] Cold Start First Request
- **Trigger:** Only on the first request after a cold start
- **Root cause:** Race in lazy initialisation
- **Fix:** Guarded the init with a double-checked lock
- **PR:** #7350, branch: fix/nan-feature-5
- **Result:** Alert stayed quiet for 14 consecutive days

### Occasion 5: [2026-07-20] Post-Retry Duplicates
- **Trigger:** Only after the client had already retried once
- **Root cause:** Missing composite index on (tenant_id, created_at)
- **Fix:** Added the composite index and backfilled in batches
- **PR:** #9231, branch: fix/nan-feature-6
- **Result:** 29 duplicate rows a day stopped being written

Note: All fixes were made to the same corner of ml/features/encoder.py, allowing context to carry over between incidents."}
